---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or methodology change for AgentRepoCoach
title: '[feature] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear description of the problem or gap. Example: "I'd like to score
Kotlin repos but no adapter exists."

## Describe the solution you'd like

What you'd like to happen. Include API sketches or config examples if
helpful.

## Describe alternatives you've considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you prefer the proposed one.

## Impact on the CAH methodology

If this changes the scoring formula (weights, sub-components, thresholds),
describe the rationale. Methodology changes require a discussion before
code lands.

## Additional context

Links to similar tools, related issues, or example use cases.
